name: io.github.travisjmurphy/loudtzu-actors-mcp
title: LOUDTZU Canada Data & Price Tools
description: 9 tools: Canadian permits, companies, recalls, charities, funding and retail prices via Apify.

environmentVariables.name: APIFY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your own Apify API token (console.apify.com > Settings > API & Integrations). Actor charges bill to this account.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_CHARGE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Per-call cap on Actor charges in USD (default 1.00).

environmentVariables.name: MAX_RETURN_ITEMS
environmentVariables.description: Max dataset items returned to the agent per call (default 200).
